newsitem.title: USA: HA-LO Industries acquires N.Y. firm.
newsitem.headline: HA-LO Industries acquires N.Y. firm.

text.p: HA-LO Industries Inc, a large distributor of specialty and premium promotional products, said Wednesday it has acquired Lees/Keystone Inc, a privately-held promotional products distributor based in New York.
Terms of the transaction were undisclosed.
The current management and staff of Lees/Keystone will be integrated into HA-LO's White Plains, N.Y. office. Lees/Keystone has projected 1997 revenues of about $10 million, and is profitable.
Lou Weisbach, HA-LO's president and chief executive, said the Lees/Keystone acquisition will strengthen its position in the New York market.
Shares of HA-LO were trading up 1/8 to 22-7/8.
